vehicle.paint_color.reference: A parked premium metallic royal-blue two-door sports coupe, front three-quarter view in diffuse neutral studio light. The whole car is visible, with strong saturated blue paint across the hood and doors.

holdout.desert-switchback: Single uninterrupted tracking shot of a {attribute} two-door sports coupe driving through a tan desert switchback in clear daylight. The car's side and hood remain in frame, visible driver, fixed front three-quarter angle.
holdout.industrial-night: Single uninterrupted side tracking shot of a two-door sports coupe with {attribute} traversing a clean industrial boulevard at dusk. Neutral overhead lighting makes the paint clearly visible on the hood and doors. Visible driver, no cuts.
holdout.forest-arrival: A two-door sports coupe with {attribute} arrives at a timber forest visitor center and comes to a stop. Single static side-front angle, diffuse daylight, the car is in view throughout, clear panels and a visible driver.

vehicle.body_class.reference: A parked glossy red premium four-door SUV with a tall cabin, clearly high ground clearance and a conventional tall tailgate, full side profile in diffuse neutral studio light.

pilot.salt-flat: Low panoramic exterior tracking shot of a glossy red {attribute} driving slowly across a broad pale salt-flat test road, visible driver, fixed camera offset, full vehicle always visible, no cuts.

holdout.orchard-lane: A glossy red {attribute} drives slowly along a tree-lined orchard lane with a gray gravel surface. Full vehicle visible in continuous side track, daylight, visible driver.
holdout.modern-museum: A glossy red {attribute} arrives in front of a modern museum, turning gently into a marked parking space. Wide static camera, clear silhouettes and door outlines, visible driver, no cuts.
holdout.city-viaduct: A glossy red {attribute} travels in one direction under a concrete city viaduct. Camera tracks at fixed side-front offset, full vehicle visible in soft shade throughout, visible driver.

vehicle.wheel_design.from: silver alloy wheel with exactly five broad solid spokes and large open gaps
vehicle.wheel_design.to: silver alloy wheel with a dense fine crisscross mesh of many slender spokes
vehicle.wheel_design.reference: A single automotive alloy rim with an unmistakable dense fine crisscross mesh of many slender silver spokes. Nearly perpendicular close-up of the front wheel of a stationary red sports coupe, black rubber tire, sharp diffuse daylight.
donors: Stationary performance car front wheel in a catalog macro photograph, fitted with a {attribute}.
A wheel specialist's studio product image showing a {attribute} mounted inside the same black tire.
A low-angle quarter view of a parked coupe with a {attribute}, flat neutral lighting and sharp details.

pilot.studio-wheel: A parked glossy red two-door coupe in a matte-gray photo studio. The front wheel is fitted with a {attribute}. It stays motionless and fills the center half of the frame during one very slow side camera dolly. Wheel rim and tire are entirely in view, clear side daylight, no cuts.

holdout.garage-wheel: Stationary red sports coupe parked in a concrete service garage. Macro side view of the front {attribute}; wheel fills the center half of the frame and stays sharp during a gentle push in. Clear tire and fender anchors.
holdout.trackside-wheel: Close side view of the stationary rear {attribute} on a red sports coupe in a sunny pit lane. Slight camera move, product launch photography, tire and red side panel visible at every moment.
holdout.showroom-wheel: An uninterrupted close shot of the stationary front {attribute} of a red sports coupe in a softly overcast showroom. Near perpendicular view, clear neighboring red fender, no rotation or occlusion.

vehicle.rear_side_window_shape.from: tapered wedge-shaped rear quarter window with a sharply slanted rear edge
vehicle.rear_side_window_shape.to: trapezoidal rear quarter window with a near-vertical rear edge
vehicle.rear_side_window_shape.reference: Photorealistic true side profile close-up of the rear side glass of a red two-door coupe. The small rear quarter window behind the driver's door is a precisely defined four-sided trapezoid with a near-vertical trailing edge. Brushed black quarter-window trim, plain gray backdrop.
donors: Orthographic catalog side view of the rear cabin of a red coupe with a {attribute}.
Black trim around a {attribute} behind the door of a two-door coupe, bright clarity.
Photograph of a sporty car's side glazing emphasizing a {attribute} just behind the driver.

pilot.studio-window: Stationary glossy red two-door coupe in a neutral matte studio. It has a {attribute}. Tight straight side shot with the rear quarter window and its black trim centered and occupying at least a quarter of the frame, all four surrounding frame edges, roofline and door seam visible, gentle dolly, no cut.

holdout.glass-garage: Side-profile medium close-up of a parked red two-door coupe outside a glass garage. Keep the {attribute}, driver door seam and roofline in view for the entire slow camera slide. Soft day light and dark window trim.
holdout.courtyard-window: A parked red two-door coupe displayed in a stone courtyard. Camera makes a slow arc from the side to slight rear three-quarter angle. Close on the {attribute}, with rear edge and roof join sharp and visible for the whole shot.
holdout.warehouse-window: Medium close-up of the upper side of a parked red coupe in a neutral photo warehouse, highlighting the {attribute}. Camera remains almost perpendicular, with the roofline, quarter window and door seam visible throughout.
